name: sol-simplify
description: Stops an agent from manufacturing process around its own work: invented gates, approval flows, verification machinery, and governance documents nobody asked for.

interface.shortDescription: Cuts the bureaucracy agents build around their own work
interface.longDescription: Keep useful product work and remove invented process. Optional review assistance preserves findings and bounds repeated automatic reviews without authorizing merges.
defaultPrompt: Review this change and preserve actionable findings.
